title: Sudden Death (cast by Cana / Pallida)
problem: Sudden Death deals damage to enemies, so it is a damaging Spell Gem and Cana / Pallida cast it as their text says. Killing one of your own creatures at the start of battle is part of the spell.
notes: Text: Cana: "This creature's first 3 permanent, damaging Spell Gems each have a 50% chance to be {ACTION_cast} automatically at the start of battle." | Pallida: "Your creatures' first 3 ... Evidence: Spell DB tag of 191 = "DAMAGE"; bc_StartupCasting L101 / L215 (DAMAGE tag; START_OF_BATTLE_FINDINGS rows 482 / 487). Reasoning: The trait texts promise damaging spells and Sudden Death is one; nothing contradicts. App note (unpatched game): Cana and Pallida can cast Sudden Death at the start of battle, which kills one of your creatures. Source: errata round 2 (2026-10-26).
